executive_summary:
This episode advances the Bride of Charlie investigation on three evidentiary axes. First, an artifact-anchored disclosure of a 92-member X group chat named "Protecting Mrs. Kirk" is presented via screenshots/quotes from X user "Shady Lady Katie," which the host ties to coordinated attacks on Candace Owens and to a previously unnamed organizer previously linked to pro-Israel intelligence work. Second, the host catalogs multiple alleged "lies and omissions" in the Tyler Robinson case narrative, but only two items in this episode meet the claim admission test on the basis of shown artifacts: a court-displayed image of Lance's phone with a damaged screen at the timestamp location, and surveillance footage of Nate Walker's movements between 12:15 and approximately 12:27 at the event venue. Third, two externally sourced interview clips – Perez Hilton's 2010 Ellen DeGeneres appearance and Piers Morgan's interview with Victor Marx – are played on air, providing artifact anchors for specific biographical claims made by Victor Marx (childhood decapitation of a cat, shooting of a handcuffed man at age 7) and for his on-air acknowledgment that false memories are possible.

Structurally, this episode expands the investigation's group-chat/dossier line of inquiry (N-10780), introduces a fresh movement-timeline target on Nate Walker (N-10781), and consolidates Tyler Robinson case-claim tracking under N-10782. The Perez Hilton segment is present primarily as commentary framed around Hollywood decline and is not anchored to investigative claims about the Charlie Kirk matter except where it crosses with the existing religious-adviser thread (Victor Marx).

claims.label: Host Says "Protecting Mrs. Kirk" Group Chat Had 92 Members Coordinating Against Her
claims.claim: The host says a group chat named "Protecting Mrs. Kirk", exposed on X, had 92 members coordinating against her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Shady Lady Katie post via X/Twitter web archives; cross-reference named accounts against public social-media activity.

claims.label: Group Chat Members Shared Candace Owens' Home Address
claims.claim: In a post by Shady Lady Katie that the host reads, members of the 'Protecting Mrs. Kirk' group chat were sharing information, background checks and reporting accounts, and even shared Candace's home address in the chat.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify quoted claim in original X post and any accompanying screenshots; cross-reference with documented doxxing reports.

claims.label: Host Says Lance's Phone Has a Damaged Screen Where the Timestamp Would Appear
claims.claim: The host says the phone of Lance (referenced in the Tyler Robinson preliminary-hearing record) was photographed by police with damage in the top-left corner of the screen at the location where the device's status-bar timestamp would appear.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original preliminary-hearing exhibit; confirm damage location and any testimony regarding when the image was captured.

claims.label: Host Says Footage Shows Nate Walker Upstairs Without His Bag by About 12:25
claims.claim: The host says footage shows Nate Walker in a bright blue shirt with his bag speaking with Dan Flood at about 12:15, then upstairs near the Hall of Flags walkway at about 12:25 without his bag, putting on sunglasses, and about two minutes later walking downstairs.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original venue surveillance footage with verified timestamps; reconcile with credentialed-assistant duty roster.

claims.label: Miami-Dade Sheriff's Deputies Responded to Perez Hilton's Residence for Live-Streamed Self-Harm
claims.claim: Per an NBC report the host reads, Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office deputies responded to Perez Hilton's Miami-area home after reports that he engaged in self-harm in a video live-streamed on social media.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office email/statement and any incident report; verify timestamp of live stream and platform takedown.

claims.label: Sheriff's Office Statement the Host Reads Says Perez Hilton Was Taken to a Local Hospital by Miami-Dade Fire Rescue
claims.claim: Per a follow-up sheriff's office statement the host reads, Perez Hilton was safely recovered after the self-harm response and taken by Miami-Dade Fire Rescue to a local hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm hospitalization via hospital records or subsequent official statements; verify family-member statement that he was alone in the residence.

claims.label: Victor Marx Explains Cutting a Cat's Head Off at Age 3 With an Adult's Hand Over His
claims.claim: In a clip of his Piers Morgan interview the host plays, asked how he could cut a cat's head off at age 3, Victor Marx asks whether Morgan could not cut the head off a dead cat if he put his hand around his son's hand on the knife.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Piers Morgan interview transcript; verify the exact wording and any prior inconsistent tellings.

claims.label: Victor Marx Stated He Shot a Handcuffed Kneeling Man at Age 7
claims.claim: In his Piers Morgan interview, Victor Marx stated that at age 7, his stepfather held his hand on a pistol aimed at a handcuffed, kneeling man who, as best he can remember, looked like a "homeless fellow", and pushed the trigger until the man was shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify statement against the full interview; cross-check with any prior public tellings; corroborate location if possible.

claims.label: Victor Marx Acknowledged False-Memory Formation Is Possible Regarding His Childhood Claims
claims.claim: When asked by Piers Morgan whether false memories could account for his childhood accounts, Victor Marx stated he had studied false memories and that this is "possible."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the full exchange; identify Victor Marx's specific trauma-specialist visit count claim (he cited 123 visits) for corroboration.

claims.label: Piers Morgan Says Mississippi-Area Law Enforcement Has No Records Matching Victor Marx's Account
claims.claim: Piers Morgan stated during the interview that local law enforcement and sheriffs in the Mississippi area where the alleged event took place have no records, police reports, or unsolved homicides matching Victor Marx's account.
claims.investigative_direction: Submit records requests to Mississippi-area sheriff and municipal police departments for the relevant time period; obtain on-record denials or confirmations.

claims.label: Host Says Daily Mail's Charlie Spiering Wrote Claiming Foreign-Operative Use of Candace Owens' Tip Line
claims.claim: Daily Mail journalist Charlie Spiering emailed the Candace Owens show stating that "sources" believe Candace is being used by foreign operatives sending misinformation through her tip line.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original email with full headers and timestamp; identify what "sources" Spearing referenced; cross-check Daily Mail coverage for follow-up.

claims.label: Perez Hilton Acknowledged Past Bullying on the 2010 Ellen DeGeneres Show and Pledged to Change
claims.claim: In a clip of the 2010 Ellen DeGeneres Show the host plays, Perez Hilton acknowledges being perceived as a "hypocrite and a bully" and pledges to stop using nasty nicknames, inappropriate doodling, and outing people on his website.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full 2010 episode recording for complete context; cross-reference with contemporaneous reporting.

claims.label: Host Says the "Protecting Mrs. Kirk" Group Chat Was Organized by an Agent of Israel
claims.claim: The host asserts that the 'Protecting Mrs. Kirk' group chat was brought together by an agent of Israel who previously said they gather intel and collaborated with a Daily Wire employee and the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation to create files on people for Israel's PR.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify organizer through leaked membership lists or named-account forensics; cross-check against Gaza Humanitarian Foundation / Daily Wire public records.

claims.label: Host Says It Is Terrifying That Group Chat Members Shared Her Address
claims.claim: The host says it is terrifying that they are sharing her address in private chats, that they seem deranged and obsessed in a way that feels dangerous, and that she would have no interest in being in a chat with 91 people about where Erika lives.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare commenter characterization against Shady Lady Katie's quoted text for consistency; pursue any screenshot evidence of the actual address disclosure.
